scope: Selected theorem-level comparisons for families 215,265,270, plus exact prior continuum target. Other families not assessed at proof level.

comparisons.openai_statement: Canonical continuum limit of 2D nearest-neighbor O(3) spins at beta→infinity, with field normalization, Schwinger convergence, OS reconstruction, positive gap and non-Gaussianity; formalization scope only finite-domain O(n) correlation decay.
comparisons.our_result: Fixed-spacing Z^3 SU(2) patterned model: named-box whole-sequence state limit and inherited representation gap alpha/16. Uniform route-B fixed-a strong-coupling certificate has an explicit weak-coupling admission obstruction.
missing_bridge: Different dimension, fields and action: S² spins vs SU(2) gauge links
No cutoff-uniform estimates or admissible g(a)→0 trajectory for present certificate
Same-field continuum normalization, reconstruction and nontriviality must be supplied
Finite-domain formalization cannot be promoted to continuum proof
comparisons.transfer_proposal: Use canonical length/field normalization and the separate field/gap/reconstruction obligations as a review template; no constants or theorem conclusions imported.

comparisons.openai_statement: Entanglement entropy area law for finite induced Z² graph with fixed finite local dimension q, bounded finite-range interactions, unique ground vector and assumed uniform global spectral gap.
comparisons.our_result: Reduced-state trace-norm locality and Wilson-loop area parity in fixed-spacing SU(2) model.
missing_bridge: 2D finite-q bounded terms differ from Z³ infinite-dimensional SU(2) link Hilbert spaces and unbounded electric terms
Global spectral gap is a premise, not an output
Entanglement entropy area law is not Wilson-loop confinement area law
Any truncation requires q-dependent constants and cutoff removal
comparisons.transfer_proposal: Consider conditional-information or tensor approximations only in a separately specified finite-q planar truncation; existence does not provide efficient tensor construction.

comparisons.openai_statement: For undeformed supersymmetric SU(N) BFSS on gauge-invariant L²(R^(9(N²−1)))⊗fermions, every fixed N≥2 has a one-dimensional zero kernel at the threshold of continuous spectrum.
comparisons.our_result: SU(2) lattice gauge-invariant spectral analysis and representation-specific vacuum simplicity.
missing_bridge: 0+1D supersymmetric matrix quantum mechanics differs from pure 3+1D Yang–Mills
Threshold zero eigenstate coexists with continuum starting at zero; it does not yield a positive spectral gap
Finite-N constants are not uniform in rank or continuum cutoff
comparisons.transfer_proposal: Retain full operator domain and norm-exhaustion checks when using deformations; no direct theorem transfer.

proposed_round2_tests.acceptance: Verify rational 2x2 family H_N=diag(0,1/N) has identical ground-state density but closing gap; independently rederive tau=96/g^4 admission thresholds and show unit rescaling does not repair a failing coupling inequality. No continuum inference.
